tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Ranked live web results (title, url, snippet, source, date when known) for a query, as JSON. Filter by age (published_within) or by site (include_domains / exclude_domains). A query with no results is not charged. $0.00435 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch one public URL (HTML, JS-heavy page or PDF) and return its readable content as clean markdown or text, ready for an LLM context. $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: search_and_read
tools.description: Web search plus the readable text of the top pages (up to 5) in one call, for research without a second round trip. $0.006 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: web_search_batch
tools.description: Up to 10 web searches in one call and one payment, results grouped per query. Cheaper per query than single searches. $0.03 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: news
tools.description: Ranked recent headlines for a topic (last day or week) with source and time, no LLM. $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: A question in, a short answer built from live pages out, with numbered source links. $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "answer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "A question in, a short answer built from live pages out, with numbered source links. $0.03 USDC per call via x402." → after: "A question in, a short answer built from live pages out, with numbered source links. $0.01 USDC per call via x402."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
